name: Pip-Pip
description: Pip-Pip is an English Marriage game for 4-10 players. Each marriage sets a new trump (like 1000, Marjapussi). Two packs (104 cards). 7 cards each; draw after each trick. Point values: 2=11, A=10, K/Q/J=5/4/3. All marriages score 50.

overview.description: Pip-Pip is an English Marriage game for 4-10 players. Each marriage sets a new trump (like 1000, Marjapussi). Two packs (104 cards). 7 cards each; draw after each trick. Point values: 2=11, A=10, K/Q/J=5/4/3. All marriages score 50.

history.origins: 20th-century British card books. Marriage family. Continental influence (1000, Marjapussi).

setup.players: Four to ten players. Described in 20th-century British card game books; the game accommodates a larger group by using two packs; play is individual (no partnerships).
setup.deck: Two standard packs shuffled together (104 cards).
setup.dealing: 7 each. Draw after each trick until stock exhausted.

rules.objective: Score points. Marriage declares trump; each marriage = 50. Point values: 2=11, A=10, K/Q/J=5/4/3. Marriage sets trump like 1000.
rules.gameplay: 1. 7 each. 2. Marriage declares trump; 50 pts. 3. Play tricks. 4. Draw one after each trick. 5. Continue until stock exhausted, then play out hand.
keyRules: Two packs. 7 each. Draw after trick.

scoring.description: Marriage 50. Card points: 2=11, A=10, K=5, Q=4, J=3.
